summary_en: Support for traditional artisans and craftspeople to strengthen skills, tools, and market access.
summary_hi: पारंपरिक कारीगरों और शिल्पकारों के कौशल, उपकरण और बाजार तक पहुंच मजबूत करने के लिए सहायता।
benefits_en: Toolkit incentive of ₹15,000, 5-7 days basic skilling with ₹500/day stipend, collateral-free loan up to ₹1 lakh (1st tranche) and ₹2 lakh (2nd tranche) at 5% concessional interest.
benefits_hi: ₹15,000 का टूलकिट प्रोत्साहन, ₹500/दिन वजीफे के साथ 5-7 दिन का बुनियादी प्रशिक्षण, और रियायती ब्याज पर ₹3 लाख तक का संपार्श्विक-मुक्त ऋण।
apply_steps_json: ["Visit your nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) with Aadhaar and bank details","Complete biometric authentication and trade registration","Submit application for verification by Gram Panchayat / Urban Local Body","Receive PM Vishwakarma Certificate and ID Card upon approval"]

summary_en: Health cover for eligible families for secondary and tertiary care at empanelled hospitals.
summary_hi: सूचीबद्ध अस्पतालों में माध्यमिक और तृतीयक देखभाल के लिए पात्र परिवारों को स्वास्थ्य सुरक्षा।
benefits_en: Cashless health cover up to ₹5,00,000 per eligible family per year for secondary and tertiary hospitalization across empanelled public and private hospitals across India.
benefits_hi: पूरे भारत में सूचीबद्ध अस्पतालों में माध्यमिक और तृतीयक देखभाल के लिए प्रति पात्र परिवार प्रति वर्ष ₹5,00,000 तक का कैशलेस स्वास्थ्य बीमा।
apply_steps_json: ["Check eligibility online at mera.pmjay.gov.in or visit nearest Ayushman Mitra at hospital","Provide Aadhaar card or Ration card for identity verification","Receive Ayushman Card instantly on mobile or physical plastic card","Avail cashless treatment at any empanelled public or private hospital"]

summary_en: A single window to discover and apply for multiple scholarship programmes across India.
summary_hi: भारत भर में कई छात्रवृत्ति कार्यक्रमों को खोजने और आवेदन करने के लिए एकल खिड़की।
benefits_en: Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) of scholarship amounts directly into student bank accounts for pre-matric, post-matric, top-class, and merit-cum-means schemes.
benefits_hi: प्री-मैट्रिक, पोस्ट-मैट्रिक और मेरिट-कम-मीन्स योजनाओं के लिए छात्रवृत्ति राशि सीधे छात्र के बैंक खाते में डीबीटी द्वारा भेजी जाती है।
apply_steps_json: ["Register on scholarships.gov.in and generate One-Time Registration (OTR) ID","Complete student profile and upload required educational certificates","Select applicable scheme based on category and institution","Submit application for institutional verification and state nodal approval"]

summary_en: A government-backed savings scheme for parents of girl children ensuring financial security for education and marriage.
summary_hi: बालिकाओं के माता-पिता के लिए शिक्षा और विवाह के लिए वित्तीय सुरक्षा सुनिश्चित करने वाली बचत योजना।
benefits_en: High guaranteed interest rate (8.2% p.a.), complete tax exemption under Section 80C, flexible deposits starting from ₹250/year, and partial withdrawal for higher education.
benefits_hi: 8.2% वार्षिक ब्याज दर, धारा 80C के तहत पूर्ण कर छूट, ₹250/वर्ष से शुरू होने वाली लचीली जमा राशि, और उच्च शिक्षा के लिए आंशिक निकासी।
apply_steps_json: ["Visit nearest Post Office or authorized commercial bank branch","Fill Account Opening Form (Form-1) for girl child below 10 years of age","Submit girl child birth certificate along with guardian's KYC documents","Deposit initial amount (minimum ₹250) and collect official passbook"]

summary_en: Financial assistance to dependent wards and widows of ex-servicemen and police personnel pursuing higher technical education.
summary_hi: उच्च तकनीकी और व्यावसायिक शिक्षा प्राप्त कर रहे पूर्व सैनिकों और पुलिस कर्मियों के आश्रितों को वित्तीय सहायता।
benefits_en: Monthly scholarship of ₹3,000 for female students and ₹2,500 for male students pursuing recognized undergraduate engineering, medical, dental, and professional degrees.
benefits_hi: मान्यता प्राप्त इंजीनियरिंग, मेडिकल और व्यावसायिक डिग्री प्राप्त करने वाली छात्राओं के लिए ₹3,000/माह और छात्रों के लिए ₹2,500/माह।
apply_steps_json: ["Visit Kendriya Sainik Board portal (ksb.gov.in) and register online","Fill the PMSS application form for professional degree course","Upload Annexures 1 & 2 verified by College Principal/Dean and Zila Sainik Board","Track approval status online and receive DBT scholarship payments directly"]

summary_en: Income support scheme providing direct financial benefit to landholding farmer families across the country.
summary_hi: देश भर के भूमिधारक किसान परिवारों को प्रत्यक्ष वित्तीय लाभ प्रदान करने वाली आय सहायता योजना।
benefits_en: Direct financial transfer of ₹6,000 per year in three equal four-monthly installments of ₹2,000 directly into Aadhaar-seeded bank accounts.
benefits_hi: आधार-सीडेड बैंक खातों में सीधे ₹2,000 की तीन समान किस्तों में प्रति वर्ष ₹6,000 का सीधा वित्तीय हस्तांतरण।
apply_steps_json: ["Visit pmkisan.gov.in and select 'New Farmer Registration'","Enter Aadhaar number and select rural or urban area","Enter land ownership record details (Khasra/Khatauni) and bank account details","Complete e-KYC via Aadhaar OTP or biometric authentication at CSC"]

summary_en: Financial grant assistance to houseless and dilapidated house dwellers in rural areas to construct pucca houses.
summary_hi: ग्रामीण क्षेत्रों में बेघर और कच्चे मकानों में रहने वालों को पक्के मकान बनाने के लिए वित्तीय अनुदान सहायता।
benefits_en: Grant of ₹1,20,000 in plains and ₹1,30,000 in hilly/difficult states plus 90-95 days of unskilled labour under MGNREGA and ₹12,000 assistance for toilet construction.
benefits_hi: मैदानी इलाकों में ₹1,20,000 और पहाड़ी राज्यों में ₹1,30,000 का अनुदान, मनरेगा के तहत 90-95 दिनों का अकुशल श्रम और शौचालय के लिए ₹12,000।
apply_steps_json: ["Gram Sabha identifies eligible beneficiaries using SECC deprivation criteria","Block Development Officer registers beneficiary on AwaasSoft portal","Geo-tagged photograph of existing kutcha house is uploaded","Installments released directly to bank account based on construction stage verification"]
